name: NOAA/NFM current best listen defaults
notes: Phase 3I files 06 and 10 were the best: speech clearly understandable, but still with static.
Do not pass the GUI's wide RF BW field to NFM listen; use the backend's default RF bandwidth and the complex FM channel low-pass instead.
Use iq_mode normal as the GUI default because file 06 was one of the best and does not require I/Q inversion. Keep invert-q as a fallback diagnostic.
